name: Wuhu
scopeLimits: The ranked WUP population-weighted point is a settlement locator, not a parcel identity, municipal boundary, or coverage guarantee. No full polygon geometry is retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official city notice documents visual lookup of city-area property natural conditions, rights status and cadastral maps; service entry is Wanshitong APP or Anhui Government Services Wuhu subsite electronic map. No open vector endpoint is published in the notice.
technicalBlocker: City bureau confirms a visual cadastral lookup, but its official link resolves to a generic government-services department list (HTTP 200, no cadastral/map text or viewer scripts) rather than the described electronic-map page. The notice publishes no vector endpoint. No anonymous polygon response was verified.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the electronic-map viewer permits anonymous access, what datasets it displays, and whether any full polygon export/API is available; no direct route was identified. The cited announcement states the “other property” cadastral query exists but does not specify access requirements.
nextStep: Retry the official Wuhu government-service electronic map when reachable; inspect its public viewer assets and network calls before testing only a small geometry-only query.
